ops-bot: PAGER: High latency on /v1/chat/completions (p99) across us-west-2, incident id INC-20240604-71

Sam (on-call): I got paged for p99 spike around 2.1s -> 4.6s. Seeing error rates still low, mostly tail latency. Paging now.

Alex (infra): Looking at the runtime dashboard — culprit appears to be mistral-16k-prod on route /v1/chat/completions (customer-facing). KV cache hit is fine, but GPU queue depth soared.

Sam (on-call): Any customer impact? Julie, can you surface any support tickets?

Julie (product): Two customers reported sluggish responses in-app but no requests failed. SLA unaffected so far, but UX hit. Notifying CS.

Sanjay (platform): Initial mitigation: can we route new requests away from mistral-16k-prod to mistral-8k-quant for non-quality-critical routes?

Alex (infra): We can do a temporary routing override policy for the chat-completions route. Doing a safe canary: 20% diversion to mistral-8k-quant, 80% to original.

Sam (on-call): Apply it. Also please bump autoscaler target from 120 to 180 for the mistral-16k pool as a shallow mitigation.

Alex (infra): Canary applied at 14:22 UTC. Autoscaler target bumped. Monitoring...

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Routing override created by alex at 14:22 UTC — rule id r-73b2. Autoscaler scaling target updated by alex.

Maria (sre): Tail latency p99 dropped from 4.6s to 2.3s within 5m of the rule. p95 stayed near 1.1s. Looks promising.

Sam (on-call): Good. I'm going to mute the noisy p95 alerts for the route while we investigate — they're flooding the channel. We'll keep p99 alerts active.

Sanjay (platform): Note: muting p95 globally is risky. Make it route-scoped: mute only /v1/chat/completions p95 for mistral-16k-prod for 3 hours.

Alex (infra): Done. Mute window set for 3h.

Julie (product): From a customer-impact POV, recommend a postmortem and a follow-up to validate fairness of routing (latency vs cost). Also want a short update to CS about temporary routing.

Sam (on-call): Agree. For the post-incident fixes, we should: 1) implement per-model, per-route p95/p99 thresholds rather than global, 2) add a compact dashboard for tail latency with model split, 3) add synthetic canaries that emulate chat workload for long-context Mistral family.

Maria (sre): I'll create the dashboard prototype: metrics: request_count, p50/p95/p99 latency, gpu_queue_depth, prefix_cache_hit, route/model labels. Show series for top 5 customers and 3 model variants.

Sanjay (platform): For thresholds, propose defaults: "low-latency" models p95=800ms p99=1800ms; "long-context" models p95=1200ms p99=2500ms. We'll tune per-model after one week of data.

Alex (infra): Adding to infra runbook: if p99 > threshold and gpu_queue_depth > 60% for >2m, do routing override + autoscaler bump + notify platform. I'll add playbook steps and example commands: 

```
# routing override example
redwoodctl routing create --route "/v1/chat/completions" --target mistral-8k-quant --percent 20 --reason "incident mitigation"

# autoscaler example
redwoodctl autoscale update --pool mistral-16k-prod --target 180
```

Sam (on-call): Nice. Create tickets for: dashboard (SRE-2345), alert config change (PLT-7890), runbook update (INF-5566). Assign Maria/Sanjay/Alex respectively.

Maria (sre): Tickets created and linked in thread. Also added retrospective note: the noisy p95 alerts were masking p99 signal; will separate alerting channels.

Julie (product): Can we also add a cost-safety check for routing to cheaper models? We should measure quality delta for customers diverted.

Sanjay (platform): Yes — add an A/B eval job post-incident to compare outputs from mistral-16k and mistral-8k-quant for a representative prompt set. We'll tag results.

Sam (on-call): Summarizing action items: 1) Dashboard prototype (Maria) 2) Per-model threshold policy and default numbers (Sanjay) 3) Runbook + CLI snippets (Alex) 4) A/B eval job for routing quality check (Sanjay/ML) 5) CS message & postmortem (Julie). I'll own the incident postmortem writeup.

ops-bot: incident-bot: Incident INC-20240604-71 acknowledged closed at 15:08 UTC — mitigations stable, no ongoing customer outages.

Sam (on-call): Closing thread. We should reconvene in the follow-up postmortem meeting next week. :thumbsup:
